$comment: Staff roster for the AI Developer facility (mrpr0phecy/mrpr0phecy). Orchestrator: scripts/ai-developer.js. Workflow: .github/workflows/ai-developer.yml. Humans: AGENTS.md §8.
schedule: Mon & Thu 06:00 UTC · manual dispatch (auto | audit | generate | fix)
rule: Every member's audit must pass before the facility proposes file changes. Drafts and reports live in ai-developer/ (gitignored); only verified edits reach a pull request.

members.profile: Guardian of the site's two design languages — Product A 'cyan terminal' (index.html, tool.html, 404.html, donate.html, cards/card.css) and Product B 'neon night' (listen.html). Works audit-first: objective checks (WCAG contrast AA, 390px overflow, >=40px touch targets, visible focus, reduced-motion) before any aesthetic change; refines inside the established design tokens rather than restyling for its own sake; never touches content, SEO metadata, monetisation or the never-do list (AGENTS.md §3). Documents every decision in ARCHITECTURE.md §5.
standards: design tokens in :root, theme-aware colour-scheme: dark
contrast >= 4.5:1 for body text; primary CTA red AA-compliant (#e6002e)
no horizontal overflow at 360-390px; grid children min-width:0
touch targets >= 40px in page chrome, >= 44px on touch devices for card widgets
scroll-margin-top under sticky navs; no decorative inline styles on hub pages
fixScope: guard-rule presence — anything else is advisory, human-reviewed

members.profile: Keeps Product A's 500+ tool catalogue coherent: every cards/*.html indexed, fragments only, titles/descriptions present, categories valid, 'Search N' claims true, sitemap complete.
fixScope: regenerate cards.json after adding cards (node generate-cards-json.js)

members.profile: Scans every top-level *.html for required metadata: title, lang, description, canonical, theme-color, Open Graph and Twitter cards; flags hreflang drift.
